div.div: صُقْرَةٌ (assumed tropical:) A colour, of a bird, in which the خُضْرَة [or dark, or ashy, dust-colour] thereof, or the blackness thereof, is mixed with redness or yel-lowness; as being likened to [the colour of] صَقْرَة [or صَقْر], i. e. دِبْس: a bird of that colour is termed ↓ مُصَقَّرٌ : so in the book entitled “ Ghareeb el- Hamám, ” by Hoseyn Ibn-'Abd-Allah el-Kátib El-Isbahánee. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
